# Batshit UserDocs LLM Map

Purpose:
- Help LLMs and docs tooling find the right Batshit UserDocs source quickly.
- Do not duplicate full docs content here.
- Treat docs/user-docs/ as the canonical public UserDocs tree.

Project:
- Name: Batshit.
- Launch posture: alpha.
- License wording: AGPL-3.0-only.
- Scope: single-user-per-instance self-hosted AI workspace.
- User content: chats, agents, prompts, workflows, artifacts, uploaded files, project files, generated content, and local data remain the user's content.
- n8n: Batshit integrates with n8n, which is separately licensed by n8n.
- Brand: Batshit trademarks/brand assets are separate from the AGPL code license.

Canonical terms:
- Primary Agents: n8n, API, CLI.
- Subagents: API Subagents, CLI Subagents, n8n Workflow Subagents, n8n Subnode Subagents.
- Batshit-original concepts (little or no outside equivalent; teach from zero): Zips, Clips, Tool Grid, DCM (Dynamic Current Message), Schema Hints, Group Chat single-speaker queue, Execution Viewer, Artifact Zones, Goons/Goon Dock.
- Do not use retired numbered primary-agent labels in public docs.
- Use Batshit in prose. All-caps brand spelling appears only inside literal env var names.
- Zip buffer counts previous agent/assistant responses, not user messages or individual tool calls. `Off` never zips; `Normal` uses buffer/threshold; `Auto` zips immediately by default. Very large tool transcripts may stay compressed even inside the buffer to protect model request size.

UserDocs information architecture:
- Pages are grouped by subject/feature, not by document type. Each subject owns its own folder.
- Install-first: Installation and Providers come first, then Security & trust, then the feature subjects, then Chat, Admin, Resources, Troubleshooting, and Reference.

Key URLs and ports:
- Mac app browser companion: http://127.0.0.1:5620
- Docker browser Batshit app: http://localhost:5620
- Source-checkout dev browser Batshit app: http://localhost:5621
- Browser batshit-server: http://localhost:5600
- Docker internal app: http://app:3000
- Docker internal batshit-server: http://batshit-server:5600
- n8n browser default: http://localhost:5678
- Docker optional n8n profile internal: http://n8n:5678
- Docker host services from app container: use host.docker.internal
- Docker Redis: internal only at redis://redis:6379/0

Setup posture:
- Mac app and Docker are peer setup paths.
- Mac app is the richer macOS workstation path for host-local runtimes and local tooling.
- Docker is the contained Compose path with explicit sidecars/operators/connect-existing rules.
- Manual source-checkout setup is advanced repair/development material, not the normal public path.
- Do not frame Docker as the default/recommended path over Mac app.
- Do not tell public users to run private development launchers as install steps.

Docker core:
- Core services: app, batshit-server, Redis 8.
- Optional profiles/add-ons: n8n, cloudflared, fbx2vrma, agent-browser, livekit, comfyui-validation.
- Core app container does not get the host Docker socket.
- Docker Sandbox and approved add-on start/stop use a host operator prepared by ./start-docker.sh.
- The Mac app uses Apple Container as the default sandbox backend for agent command execution on supported Macs; Docker Sandbox remains selectable and cross-platform.

n8n:
- n8n workflows and credentials stay in n8n.
- Batshit Settings API keys are not copied into n8n provider credentials.
- Current official Batshit n8n Native Tools use scoped `x-batshit-native-tool-token`.
- Current public-safe n8n templates live in docs/user-docs/user-templates/batshit-official-n8n-workflow-templates/.

Portable Skills:
- Portable Skills are Batshit system-skill bundles installed into outside coding agents.
- Operational bundles operate local Batshit through GET /api/health, POST /api/controls/use, optional POST /api/controls/find, and x-batshit-portable-token.
- Informational bundles (currently the Portable Batshit Guide) carry docs-only references and need no token at all.
- Tokens are minted in Settings -> Skills & Prompts -> Portable Skills, scoped by family, shown once, and revocable.
- Never tell users to paste BATSHIT_TOKEN, passwords, browser cookies, or n8n callback tokens into outside agents.
- The Portable Skills tab shows copy-ready install prompts for the six public bundle zips.
- Public bundles are served under /portable-skills/ and listed in docs/user-docs/reference/portable-skills.md.
- Private env files should normally live at ~/.batshit/portable-skills/portable-skills.env, not inside downloaded bundles. Per-skill env files are optional narrower-token overrides.

Security/documentation constraints:
- Never publish real tokens, API keys, private local paths, raw logs, or secrets.
- For bug reports, prefer Settings -> Admin -> Diagnostics and the previewed diagnostics zip over manual raw-log collection.
- Explain Mac app and Docker security honestly; neither is magically safe.
- Prefer sandboxed Agent Mode for normal agent command execution when documenting usage.
- Warn against untrusted skills, MCP gateways, artifacts, and n8n workflows.
- Explain that enabling a Skill for an agent gives that agent permission to load it when a matching request comes up; users do not have to type the slash command first.
